༄༅/ /chos kyi rje rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod (ga)pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod (ga)pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so//

ka) rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar phan bde'i 'byung gnas bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po/ kha) rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam par thar pa dngos grub kyi dga' ston/ ga) rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar kha skong dad 'dun yid kyi shing rta ngoms byed/ nga) rje karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes bstod pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyi 'dod 'jo/ ca) dwags po paṇa chen gsung rab mang thos pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'gro ba'i bla ma/ cha) rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ ja) thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag chen mo dngos grub char 'bebs/ nya) thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang gi nang bzhugs kyi dkar chag rin chen bang mdzod/ ta) thugs dam mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gi nang gi dkar chag tha) bka' bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rnam par dbye ba la log rtog kun sel/ da) sgrub brgyud rin po che'i khyad chos lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad kyi dris lan/ na) rje rin po che la nang so rgya mtsho bas zhus pa sdom gsum gyi dris lan pa) dge slong kun dga' shes rab la gdams pa'i sdom gsum dris lan/ pha) sa bka' rnying gsum dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba snying po'i don gsal ba/ ba) lcag ge dge slong rin chen bzang po la gdams pa'i zhus lan 'od phreng*/ ma) gangs dkar ras chen pas zhus pa'i lan/ tsa) dpal ri bo che'i sgom chen mtsho skyes la gdams pa'i zhus lan mdo 'gag rin po che'i phreng ba/ tsha) shel ma sgom chen la gdams pa'i zhus lan ma rig mun sel/ dza) khyung tshang pa rin chen bzang po la gdams pa/ wa) khams kyi bla chen la gdams pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi khrid tshigs bcad ma/ zha) rgya ston rtogs ldan la gdams pa/ za) nā tha maṅga la gdams pa gegs sel gyi man ngag 'a) rtogs ldan 'ba' ra pa la gdams pa'i gsol 'debs/ ya) kong po rtogs ldan kun dga' rgyal po la gdams pa/
